pitch: On a summer evening in Grandma's big garden, Mia finds a baby star asleep in an old lantern. With her fox friend Tuck, she carries it down to Willow Pond, where the fireflies fly up to the sky at moonrise: the star's ride home.
theme: Helping someone find their way home, and that asking friends for help is a strength.

craft.payoff: Warm and proud: Mia helped a little star get home, and her friends helped her do it.

cast.name: Mia
cast.personality: Curious, cheerful, a little impatient, and kind. Loves to sing. Brave in small, real ways.
cast.refrain: Little light, little light, show me the way tonight!
cast.look: A 6-year-old girl with fair skin with warm peach undertones, a round face, big dark eyes and wavy chestnut hair in two short ponytails tied with yellow ribbons. A bright yellow raincoat with big round wooden buttons, worn open over a blue-and-white striped T-shirt and navy shorts. Red rubber boots.

cast.name: Tuck
cast.personality: A cheerful show-off with a big heart. Always sure he knows a shortcut; his shortcuts are never short (the running joke).
cast.refrain: I know a shortcut! ... Almost there!
cast.look: A small young red fox, as tall as Mia's knee on four legs. Orange-red fur, cream-white chest, cheeks and muzzle, black 'socks' on his legs, a big bushy tail with a white tip, bright amber eyes and a friendly grin (no visible teeth). Always wears a knitted green scarf that's a bit too long, one end flapping.

cast.name: Glim
cast.personality: A baby star who can't talk: it hums (hmm-mmm) and twinkles. Its glow shows how it feels.
cast.look: A baby star the size of a plum, with five short, soft, rounded points (like a cookie cutter star, not spiky). Pale gold, glowing warmly from inside with a soft halo. Two small dot eyes, a tiny smile, rosy-peach glow on its cheeks. Bright gold when happy, dim and peach-colored when sleepy, flickering when it giggles.

cast.name: Grandma
cast.personality: Calm, warm, playful. Never worried, never cross.
cast.look: Mia's grandmother: tall and slim, warm brown skin, short silver-gray curly hair, round red glasses, a long purple knitted cardigan over a green dress, soft slippers.

cast.name: Bramble
cast.personality: Flustered, polite, very fond of apples.
cast.look: A small round hedgehog: brown spines with cream tips, a pale cream face, a black button nose, tiny pink feet.

cast.name: Gertie
cast.pronounce: GUR-tee, with a hard G as in "girl"
cast.look: A big, fluffy, round white goose with an orange beak and orange feet, droopy sleepy eyelids and two grumpy feather-tuft eyebrows that soften when she smiles.

extras.name: The moths
extras.look: Soft, fuzzy, pale cream moths with rounded wings and feathery antennae, like little snowflakes. Cute and simple, not insect-detailed.

extras.name: The frogs
extras.look: A chorus of small, round green frogs with pale yellow bellies, sitting on lily pads. The biggest one, the leader, has a puffy throat that balloons when he sings.

extras.name: The fireflies
extras.look: Mostly seen as warm golden-green dots of light with soft glows. Up close: tiny round bodies with little wings, cute, not buggy.

props.name: The lantern
props.look: A small old brass lantern the size of a teapot: a round glass belly, a domed top with a ring handle, a tiny hinged glass door at the front with a round knob, and a small dent on its left side. A little tarnished, greenish in the corners.
views: front, side and back, door closed, with a plain warm glow inside (no Glim)
three-quarter view with the little door open
held by its ring handle in a child's hand, to show the size

places.look: Grandma's small white cottage at the top of the gently sloping garden: a blue door and a porch with a warm yellow lamp. Seen from the garden, it's small and far, always lit.
The wild middle of the garden: tall, whispery grass with clover and dandelion clocks. Mia's red ball is lost here.
A tall, thick green hedge along one side of the garden, with a low leafy tunnel through it. Grandma's tall sunflowers grow where the tunnel comes out.
Grandma's swept path of pale flagstones, winding down past bean poles, fat orange pumpkins, a strawberry bed and big cabbages.

A clear, shallow, ankle-deep brook across the bottom of the garden, pebbles visible, ferns on the banks. Three round, flat stepping stones cross it. Further along, a small arched wooden footbridge with a rope rail.
A round pond just past the brook, still in Grandma's garden, under a huge weeping willow. Lily pads, reeds and cattails. A low hill behind it, where the moon rises.

worldRules: At dusk, the garden animals talk to Mia. Grown-ups don't hear them.
Glim can't talk. It hums, and its glow shows how it feels.
A star that falls can ride home with the fireflies of Willow Pond when the moon comes up.
Everything happens inside Grandma's garden. Grandma's porch light can always be seen.
never: Mia never leaves the garden, gets lost, or is alone without Tuck after page 3.
Nobody gets hurt. The dark is never scary.
No sharp teeth, no scary faces, no deep water.
Grandma is never worried or cross.
Glim is never trapped: it curled up in the lantern to stay warm, and the little door is never locked.
